## Dubai South

URL: https://expertcarerealestate.com/areas/dubai-south/

The planned city around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai, with townhouses, villas and low-rise apartments and the Expo station at the end of the Red Line.

Dubai South is the district built around Al Maktoum International Airport on the southern edge of the city. It launched as Dubai World Central and took its current name in 2015. Expo City Dubai, the former Expo 2020 site, sits on its northern side and is now a neighbourhood of its own.
Buyers find townhouses, villas and low-rise apartments rather than towers. Emaar South is built around an 18-hole golf course; The Pulse and South Bay are the main communities in the Residential District; Expo City is adding apartment buildings and villas of its own, such as Sky Residences and Mangrove Residences. Much of the stock is off-plan or newly handed over.
For tenants, the pull is the airport, the free zone and the space. Expo 2020 station, the terminus of the Red Line's Route 2020 branch, sits at Expo City; the rest of the district is a car area. Two nurseries sit inside the Residential District, and South View School is in Remraam next door.
If you are selling, your buyer is an airport or free-zone employee, or an investor who is betting on the airport expansion. A townhouse with a garden in a handed-over phase is easier to sell than an apartment, because that is what most tenants here are looking for.

Homes: Townhouses and villas in gated communities; Low-rise apartments in the Residential District and Expo City; Golf-course homes in Emaar South.
Suits: Buyers who work at the airport, in Expo City or in Jebel Ali; Families who want a townhouse and a garden; Investors buying before the airport expansion.
Getting around: Dubai Metro Red Line, Route 2020 branch: Expo 2020 station at Expo City Dubai, the end of the line. Al Maktoum International Airport is inside the district. Road access from Expo Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road.
Master developer: Dubai South.
Ownership: freehold, open to buyers of any nationality.

### Questions

**Can foreigners buy property in Dubai South?**
Yes. Dubai South is a freehold area, so buyers of any nationality can own homes there outright, and they do not need to live in the UAE to buy.

**What types of property are there in Dubai South?**
Townhouses and villas in gated communities, low-rise apartments in the Residential District and Expo City and golf-course homes in Emaar South.

**How do you get around Dubai South by public transport?**
Dubai Metro Red Line, Route 2020 branch: Expo 2020 station at Expo City Dubai, the end of the line. Al Maktoum International Airport is inside the district. Road access from Expo Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road.

**Who is Dubai South a good fit for?**
Buyers who work at the airport, in Expo City or in Jebel Ali; families who want a townhouse and a garden; and investors buying before the airport expansion.

**Who is the master developer of Dubai South?**
Dubai South.

**What are the landmarks in Dubai South?**
Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Terra, Emaar South golf course and The Pulse.

**Which schools and nurseries are near Dubai South?**
CreaKids Nursery (Residential District); Little Woods Nursery (Residential District); and South View School (Remraam, nearby).

**Who rents in Dubai South?**
Tenants are airport, Expo City and Jebel Ali employees who want a townhouse or a garden apartment close to work.

**What should I know before selling a home in Dubai South?**
Buyers here want to know which phase your home sits in and when the roads and shops around it were completed, so have the handover papers ready.

**What are the costs of buying a home in Dubai South?**
The same fees apply across Dubai. A ready home carries the 4% DLD transfer fee, AED 520 in title deed fees, the registration trustee fee and usually a 2% agency fee plus VAT; an off-plan home carries 4% Oqood registration plus AED 20. The [buying costs calculator](https://expertcarerealestate.com/buying-costs/) works it out for any price.

## Arjan

URL: https://expertcarerealestate.com/areas/arjan/

A freehold district in Dubailand beside Dubai Miracle Garden, with low- and mid-rise apartment buildings between Al Barsha South and Motor City.

Arjan is a district inside Dubailand, developed by Dubai Properties, at the junction of Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Umm Suqeim Street. Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden sit on its edge, and Al Barsha South, Motor City and JVC are its neighbours.
Buyers get apartments, mostly studios to three-bedrooms, in low- and mid-rise buildings with shops on the ground floor. Villas are rare. Mashriq Elite's Floareá Residence, with 206 homes, is complete and lived in, and its Floareá Grandé is in the same district.
For tenants, Arjan is one of the lower-rent addresses close to the schools of Al Barsha South, including Nord Anglia, Brighton College and Repton. There is no Metro station; RTA buses F36 and F37 serve the district, and Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Internet City are the nearest Red Line stations by car.
If you are selling, your buyer is a first-time buyer or an investor who wants a tenant quickly. Buildings here are judged on their pool, gym and management before their finish, so a completed building with a good record and a garden view is what sells.

Homes: Studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments; Low- and mid-rise buildings with ground-floor shops; Ready homes and off-plan buildings.
Suits: First-time buyers; Investors looking for rental homes; Families who want the Al Barsha South schools close.
Getting around: No Metro station. RTA bus routes F36 and F37 serve the district. Nearest Red Line stations by car: Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Internet City.
Master developer: Dubai Properties (Dubai Holding).
Ownership: freehold, open to buyers of any nationality.

### Questions

**Can foreigners buy property in Arjan?**
Yes. Arjan is a freehold area, so buyers of any nationality can own homes there outright, and they do not need to live in the UAE to buy.

**What types of property are there in Arjan?**
Studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments, low- and mid-rise buildings with ground-floor shops and ready homes and off-plan buildings.

**How do you get around Arjan by public transport?**
No Metro station. RTA bus routes F36 and F37 serve the district. Nearest Red Line stations by car: Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Internet City.

**Who is Arjan a good fit for?**
First-time buyers, investors looking for rental homes and families who want the Al Barsha South schools close.

**Who is the master developer of Arjan?**
Dubai Properties (Dubai Holding).

**What are the landmarks in Arjan?**
Dubai Miracle Garden, Dubai Butterfly Garden, Floareá Residence by Mashriq Elite and Floareá Grandé by Mashriq Elite.

**Which schools and nurseries are near Arjan?**
Safa Community School; Dubai Heights Academy; Nord Anglia International School Dubai (Al Barsha South, nearby); Brighton College Dubai (Al Barsha South, nearby); Repton School Dubai (Al Barsha South, nearby); Happy Bees Early Learning Centre; and Chubby Cheeks Nursery.

**Who rents in Arjan?**
Tenants are young professionals and families with children at the Al Barsha South schools who want a new apartment and a lower rent than Dubai Hills next door.

**What should I know before selling a home in Arjan?**
Buyers compare your apartment with the new buildings still being released around it, so a completed building with a strong management record is your advantage.

**Which areas are next to Arjan?**
Jumeirah Village Circle and Dubai Hills Estate.

**What are the costs of buying a home in Arjan?**
The same fees apply across Dubai. A ready home carries the 4% DLD transfer fee, AED 520 in title deed fees, the registration trustee fee and usually a 2% agency fee plus VAT; an off-plan home carries 4% Oqood registration plus AED 20. The [buying costs calculator](https://expertcarerealestate.com/buying-costs/) works it out for any price.
